title: Build a recoverable image classifier through exported inference
hardware: CPU; target-device extension requires separate validation

stages.title: Image data and preprocessing
stages.evidence: Channel/range/layout references, PNG ingestion, source-group split manifest
stages.diagnosis: Reject ambiguous input ranges and review source groups before fitting.

stages.title: Transparent CNN baseline
stages.evidence: Shape trace, independent receptive field, parameter count and finite difference
stages.diagnosis: Check NHWC/HWIO axes and preserve singleton batches.

stages.title: Actual augmented training
stages.evidence: Tiny-set fit, post-update train/held-out curves, seed replay
stages.diagnosis: Distinguish augmented minibatch pre-update loss from unaugmented full-set evaluation.

stages.title: Full-state recovery
stages.evidence: Fresh-process next IDs, augmented inputs, losses and optimizer/key/cursor equality
stages.diagnosis: Weights alone omit momentum, randomness and the next sampler position.

stages.title: Frozen evaluation and errors
stages.evidence: Unequal-batch metric parity, confusion counts and aligned corruption errors
stages.diagnosis: Read rows as truth, columns as predictions; inspect removed information before explaining failure.

stages.title: Calibrated precision
stages.evidence: Training-only scales, actual integer accumulations, clipping, logit errors and byte counts
stages.diagnosis: Separate weight, activation, accumulation and float intermediate operations.

stages.title: Serialized inference artifact
stages.evidence: Actual JAX graph reload in a fresh interpreter, signatures and contract guards
stages.diagnosis: Verify payload hashes and preprocessing/class mappings before inference.

stages.title: Measured serving adapter
stages.evidence: Warmup, repeated completed CPU inference, failed candidate and rollback trace
stages.diagnosis: State decoding exclusions, actual device and timing units; avoid unsupported target speed claims.

rubric: Validate raw image channels/layout/range and external-file provenance without split leakage
Verify convolution/pooling/head independently and check a parameter derivative
Train an actual image model with isolated augmentation and reproducible input order
Restore complete optimizer/random/sampler state in a fresh process and compare next updates
Explain frozen confusion counts and aligned corrupted-image failures
Calibrate training-only weight/activation scales and execute int32 accumulation with clipping evidence
Deserialize actual exported computation and preserve preprocessing/class/signature parity
Rehearse failed-candidate handling and rollback before reporting completed CPU timings
setupNote: Use the extracted top-level folder containing requirements-cpu.txt and projects/image-harness. The synthetic image fixture needs no download; an optional manifest loads existing local image files. Export and restore checks launch bounded fresh CPU interpreters.
